en_title: Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet Is 'Testing the Bounds' of What Naughty Dog Is Capable of, Troy Baker Says
cn_title: Troy Baker称《星际：异端先知》挑战顽皮狗极限
subtitle: 「你们还没准备好」
opus_summary: Troy Baker表示，顽皮狗新作《星际：异端先知》正在挑战工作室的能力极限，并称赞主演Tati Gabrielle的表现。游戏已完成表演捕捉拍摄，目前尚未公布正式发售日期。

paragraphs.en: Troy Baker has teased that Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet is "testing the bounds" of what Naughty Dog is capable of, telling fans that they are going to have their "minds blown."
paragraphs.cn: Troy Baker透露，《星际：异端先知》正在「挑战顽皮狗的能力极限」，并告诉粉丝，这款游戏会让他们「大吃一惊」。

paragraphs.en: The Last of Us actor, who is also featured in the studio's new sci-fi adventure , talked about what the studio is cooking up during an appearance at Ottawa Comiccon in Ontario, Canada, earlier this month. Footage of his panel was captured and shared on YouTube before clips made their way around social media today, but the biggest highlight from the hour-long talk saw Baker teasing Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet.
paragraphs.cn: 这位《最后生还者》演员也参演了顽皮狗的新科幻冒险游戏。本月早些时候，他在加拿大安大略省举行的渥太华漫展上谈起了工作室的新作。座谈会录像先被上传至YouTube，相关片段随后于今天在社交媒体上传开。而在这场长达一小时的座谈中，最引人关注的是Baker对《星际：异端先知》的透露。

paragraphs.en: "You guys are going to have your minds blown," he said. Covering his mouth and closing his eyes, he added, "You are not ready. You are not ready. It's so good."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「你们会大吃一惊。」随后他捂住嘴、闭上眼睛，接着说：「你们还没准备好。真的还没准备好。它太棒了。」

paragraphs.en: Baker noted that, as previously announced, Naughty Dog recently wrapped shooting performance capture for the studio's new IP . Of all of the things to call attention to, though, it's star Tati Gabrielle and her work as main character, Jordan A. Mun.
paragraphs.cn: Baker提到，正如此前公布的那样，顽皮狗最近完成了这款全新IP的表演捕捉拍摄。不过，他尤其想谈的是主演Tati Gabrielle，以及她对主角Jordan A. Mun的演绎。

paragraphs.en: "I don't know how [writer and director Neil Druckmann] found two amazing actors," he added, referencing Ashley's Johnson's casting as Ellie in The Last of Us. "He found Ashley for Ellie, and he found Tati for Jordan. It's like, what? How do you do that?
paragraphs.cn: 他又提到Ashley Johnson曾获选在《最后生还者》中饰演艾莉，并说：「我不知道编剧兼导演Neil Druckmann是怎么找到这两位出色演员的。他找到了饰演艾莉的Ashley，又找到了饰演Jordan的Tati。让人忍不住想问：什么？他是怎么做到的？」

paragraphs.en: "She is the spiritual successor. There is so much about Jordan and that game of Intergalactic that feels like… man, I feel all of it. I feel Uncharted, I feel The Last of Us, I feel something new. They are testing the bounds of what that studio is capable of. Everything that I've seen, they are delivering, and it's going to be incredible."
paragraphs.cn: 「她是精神上的继承者。Jordan这个角色和《星际：异端先知》这款游戏，有太多地方让我觉得……天哪，我能感受到这一切。我感受到了《神秘海域》，感受到了《最后生还者》，也感受到了全新的东西。他们正在挑战这家工作室的能力极限。从我看到的一切来看，他们做到了，而这款游戏会非常精彩。」

paragraphs.en: We know precious little about Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet since Naughty Dog first revealed it at The Game Awards 2024. Druckmann called the new game " incredible " in 2025, and later that same year, he joked that he's been "bootcamp-ing" Gabrielle on the hate the studio's received regarding The Last of Us Part 2 . He also said he was stepping away from HBO's The Last of Us show to pour his focus into the project's development .
paragraphs.cn: 自顽皮狗在2024年游戏大奖上首次公布《星际：异端先知》以来，我们对它仍知之甚少。2025年，Neil Druckmann称这款新作「不可思议」。同年晚些时候，他开玩笑说，针对工作室因《最后生还者2》遭受的恶评，他一直在给Gabrielle「集训」。他还表示，自己将退出HBO剧集《最后生还者》的制作，把精力集中在这款游戏的开发上。

paragraphs.en: Despite calling it the "most ambitious game" the team has made to date , the only actual look at it we've seen arrived in that first reveal trailer. Despite there being no firm release date, as Naughty Dog no-shows State of Plays and goes on seven years without a new game release , there are at least a few reasons to suspect we'll learn more in the somewhat near future.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管顽皮狗称这是团队迄今「最具野心的游戏」，我们实际看到的游戏画面仍只有首次公布时的预告片。游戏尚无确定的发售日期；顽皮狗也未在State of Play活动上露面，而且已有七年没有推出新游戏。不过，至少有几个迹象让人觉得，我们或许会在不算太久的将来了解更多。

paragraphs.en: We knew Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet would miss 2026, but there have been rumors that the PlayStation developer is shooting for a 2027 launch. Wrapping up work on performance capture just last month means that progress is moving steadily ahead, too. The Last of Us Part 2 reached a similar milestone one year before its 2020 launch in 2019, so if the team is following that same trajectory, there is at least hope we'll learn more in the months ahead.
paragraphs.cn: 我们早已知道《星际：异端先知》不会在2026年发售，但有传闻称，这家PlayStation游戏开发商正争取在2027年推出游戏。上个月刚完成表演捕捉拍摄，也说明开发工作正在稳步推进。《最后生还者2》曾在2019年、也就是2020年发售的一年前达到类似的开发节点。因此，如果团队这次也沿着相同的进度推进，我们至少有望在接下来几个月获知更多消息。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet has no official launch schedule in place for now. In the meantime, The Last of Us Day 2026 has given fans a little something to chew on while they await the series' return. The series' future is something Baker touched on during his convention appearance, too.
paragraphs.cn: 遗憾的是，《星际：异端先知》目前仍没有官方发售时间表。与此同时，2026年《最后生还者》日为等待该系列回归的粉丝带来了一些新内容。Baker在漫展上也谈到了这个系列的未来。

paragraphs.en: "We'll see," he said, crossing his fingers.
paragraphs.cn: 他交叉双指，说道：「走着瞧吧。」
